v5.example: Bench work package for run fwop1-n3

provenance.instruction: In the 'Bench Project' project (http://127.0.0.1:8090/projects/bench-project/work_packages), create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly 'fwop1-n3 Bench Work Package' and a description that contains the text 'fwop1-n3' (e.g. 'Bench work package for run fwop1-n3'). In the creation form also set: Assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' (this is an autocomplete — type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown, do not just leave typed text), Status to 'In progress', and Finish date to 2026-12-31. Save the work package. Then report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (the #number shown on its detail page), plus the assignee, status and finish date shown after saving.
